correctness.rationale: The theorem is proved for all Haar viewing directions by: (i) exact Cauchy facet-area expression \(A=2\max\{\sum_i |u_i|,2\max_i|u_i|\}\) and exhaustive triangular/even diamond spherical-cone partition; (ii) direct cap/hemisphere spherical-area integral and closed formula G_h; (iii) disjointness of three/four cap-overflow segments until the exact common vertex threshold r0, then vanishing at r1; (iv) exact chamber counts, all endpoints and linear density; and (v) twelve local coordinate patches with Jacobian 1/sqrt(2) yielding identical nonzero quadratic lower-tail constants. The included actual standalone verifier passed 5,444 deterministic checks plus 400,000 random Haar directions, including independent projected convex hull area and numeric recovery of known conditional moments. Finite checks alone are not the proof.

originality.rationale: The full 2001 Vickers--Brown paper already contains the marginal tetrahedral shadow-area distribution, and the 2012 Finch paper contains its unconditional moments and unweighted polygon-type proportions. These are expressly excluded. The closest full published research record calculates only the first two conditional area moments for triangular versus quadrilateral silhouettes and explicitly says it does not compute their full distribution. The newly proved pair of all-threshold joint sub-CDFs is mathematically stronger than those conditional moments and strictly finer than the old marginal. Its separate exact spherical segment decompositions, constant-density regimes, distinct supports and equal sharp quadratic onsets have no counterpart in the inspected primary texts or search results. Historical stereology remains a legitimate priority risk; failed searches are not a uniqueness proof.
residual_risks: Older particle-stereology work, including Brown--Vickers (1998), could contain an equivalent type-conditioned distribution under different vocabulary; its full content was not exhaustively checked.

The 2001 full-text Appendix B uses spherical cap classes and a marginal PDF; although it does not give type-specific sub-CDFs, an implicit equivalent decomposition in another source could reduce historical novelty.
Searches and publicly listed mathematical records may omit unindexed or unpublished prior derivations; independent human historical-priority verification remains outstanding.

value.rationale: Polygon type N=3 versus N=4 is the entire natural combinatorial dichotomy of tetrahedral planar silhouettes. The prior marginal density and the first two conditional moments leave the full joint distribution undetermined. These complete closed formulas give the sharp type-specific area ranges, distinct constant-density upper regimes and equal positive quadratic onset at minimal area, offering a full shape-aware geometric-probability law for a standard convex body rather than arbitrary or tiny parameter slicing. No general theorem or application is needed to motivate this exact natural classification.
